summary: rwc-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, chmods it executable, and uses it via execFileSync to run math_init.js — a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle shipped in the package. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated (javascript-obfuscator-style identifier mangling and rotating string-table lookups), and math_init.js uses a WV8StW array-rotator with a large mixed literal array. The package advertises itself as a rich web chat client, and none of that purpose requires downloading a second JavaScript runtime at install time to execute an unrelated, obfuscated payload named math_init. The alternate-runtime invocation is used to run bytes that Node-based scanners and reviewers cannot readily inspect, giving whoever published this arbitrary code execution on the installer host on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
